key_insight: An LLM-guided redesign of a magnesium stent reduced a high-percentile bend-strain objective by 32% while working with about 1,650 CAD parameters and a budget of 15 simulations.
engineering_relevance: AI-guided CAD editing could enable coordinated component redesign when nonlinear simulations are expensive and conventional optimisation struggles with large design spaces.
method: GPT-6 Astra proposed changes through a CAD geometry parametrisation.
Each proposal was built, meshed and evaluated with large-deformation plasticity and contact.
The LLM used full simulation results to guide subsequent design changes.
evidence_signal: Under the same simulation budget, Tosca improved the objective by about 10%; an earlier LLM design independently evaluated through full deployment showed 14% lower strain and 63% less damage at the most damaged spot.
watch_item: Evidence is limited to one component study, and the independent higher-fidelity validation assessed an earlier design rather than the final 32%-improved design.
paper_title: AI agents can redesign engineering parts with more than a thousand CAD parameters and nonlinear simulations
